fixes.title: Target header card under-reports planned exposures and integration time by the loop multiplier - including for every sequence the app's own Quick-Start Wizard builds
fixes.summary: Closed by the immediately-preceding wave, and closed at the cause rather than by a message. TargetHeaderCard._calculateTargetPlan no longer has its own walk: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/target_header_card.dart:675-678 delegates to the shared plannedCaptureUnder() in packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/plan_math.dart:79-154, whose visit() compounds a count-loop multiplier at plan_math.dart:130-137 (childMult = mult * (node.repeatCount ?? 1)) exactly as Sequence._countExposures does, and raises hasUnboundedRepeat for non-count loops so a one-pass floor is labelled as such (target_header_card.dart:535-545). The wizard tree (TargetHeader > Loop x10 > Exposure 1x120s) now renders '10 planned exposures - 20m', matching the toolbar and the stored estimated_duration_mins. The same defect on the LIVE counter (the card flipping to '1/1 done - 100%' after the first of ten frames) is closed in packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/target_progress_provider.dart:126 (totalFrames += node.count * mult) with an explicit completionUnknown flag (:38-59, :77-88) so a looped target renders its plan instead of a ratio over a floor. The library preview (sequence_card.dart:520) and the run dashboard (run_dashboard/target_header_panel.dart:348-366) read the same two sources, so the four surfaces cannot diverge again. I verified no surface quotes a number the other three contradict, including the smart-exposure case where the run dashboard suppresses the row (target_header_panel.dart:349) instead of printing '0 frames planned'.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/widgets/target_header_card_plan_test.dart (6 tests, pumps the real TargetHeaderCard over the production CurrentSequenceNotifier) + packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/sequence/target_progress_provider_test.dart (13 tests). Both green: 6/6 and 13/13.
fixes.revert_check: Reverted packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/plan_math.dart:133 from 'childMult = mult * (node.repeatCount ?? 1);' to 'childMult = mult;' -> target_header_card_plan_test.dart 4 passed / 2 FAILED ('count loop multiplies the target plan', 'nested count loops compound the multiplier'). Restored -> 6/6 pass. Separately reverted packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/target_progress_provider.dart:126 from 'totalFrames += node.count * mult;' to 'totalFrames += node.count;' -> target_progress_provider_test.dart 9 passed / 4 FAILED. Restored -> 13/13 pass. The card test failing on a plan_math edit is itself the wiring proof: the rendered widget text comes from the shared walk, not from a copy inside the card.
fixes.caveats: The two counting paths are still separate code (plan_math counts SmartExposure + SciencePhotometry; target_progress_provider counts ExposureNode only). That is deliberate - the live counter can only attribute frames it can see per node - and no surface prints the smaller number as a plan, but it is the seam where a future divergence would appear.

fixes.title: Exposure Triggers dialog lets you add and Save a trigger, then silently discards it when the selected node cannot hold triggers
fixes.summary: Closed by the preceding wave under the verifier's corrected condition (no ExposureNode in the sequence at all, not 'wrong node selected'). packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/sequence_toolbar.dart:160-162 resolves the exposure nodes up front; :526-534 disables the bell and puts the reason in the tooltip ('Exposure Triggers (add an exposure node first)'), so the action is dead in both the toolbar and the compact overflow menu (they render from the same _ToolbarAction list, :554-558); :171-181 keeps a hard guard so no future caller can open a dialog whose Save is a no-op; and :182-191 passes an appliesTo subtitle naming the node(s) being edited. I checked the rule against the executor rather than trusting it: native/skotiq_native/sequencer/src/node/instructions/expose.rs:343,719-749 is the only instruction that evaluates triggers, so 'there must be an ExposureNode' is the real storage constraint and not a UI invention.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/sequence_toolbar_exposure_triggers_test.dart - 2 tests on the real SequenceToolbar: the no-exposure sequence asserts the reason-bearing tooltip AND that a tap opens no TriggerConfigurationDialog; the with-exposure sequence asserts the dialog names its owner and that Save lands on that node's triggers list in the editor state. 2/2 green.
fixes.revert_check: Reverted sequence_toolbar.dart:528-533 to the unconditional form ('label: Exposure Triggers$lockedTooltipSuffix' / 'onPressed: canEdit ? openExposureTriggers : null') AND deleted the :172-181 exposureNodes.isEmpty guard -> 'with no exposure node the action is disabled and says why' FAILED (tooltip finder found 0 widgets, and the dialog opens). Restored both -> 2/2 pass.
fixes.caveats: One adjacent hole I judged out of scope and did NOT change: the dialog seeds from exposureNodes.first (:164-169) and Save writes to every exposure node (:200-202). Since the bell is the only editor of ExposureNode.triggers in the app, in-app triggers are always sequence-wide and identical, so the read is exact; an IMPORTED sequence carrying per-node triggers would be flattened on Save - disclosed by the appliesTo line ('Applies to all N exposure nodes in this sequence.') but not prevented.

fixes.title: Mosaic Wizard invents a camera field of view and plans the whole mosaic from it, while the framing dialog on the same screen correctly refuses to guess
fixes.summary: Closed by the preceding wave. packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/mosaic_wizard_dialog.dart:56-91 introduces _PanelSizeSource, whose default is 'unknown' (:89) - the 60'x40' field initialisers are now an inert placeholder rather than a claim. initState (:143-151) seeds from the rig via opticalConfigProvider.fieldOfView, which returns null unless focal length AND sensor geometry are all present (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/models/optical_config.dart:46-52), i.e. exactly when the wizard must admit it does not know. When unknown: the Plan summary prints 'unknown' instead of a degree figure (:887-889), a banner repeats the framing dialog's own wording (:1011-1040), and BOTH build actions are disabled with the reason in their tooltips - 'Load into Sequencer' (:793-806) and 'Create mosaic project' (:809-833). A user-typed panel size under Advanced counts as known (:949-956), so the wizard is still usable without a profile. I also checked the other mosaic entry point for the same invention: packages/skotiq_app/lib/utils/plan_tonight_sequencer_helper.dart:453-467 already refuses to build when the equipment FOV is unavailable.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/widgets/mosaic_wizard_visual_test.dart - 'with no rig it says the panel size is unknown and refuses to build' (asserts the banner, the rendered 'unknown', the ABSENCE of '1.00 deg x 0.67 deg', and onPressed == null on both keyed buttons) plus 'with a rig the panel size is the rig's field, not 60x40' (500 mm + 4144x2822 at 4.63 um -> '2.20 deg x 1.50 deg'). 7/7 green.
fixes.revert_check: Reverted mosaic_wizard_dialog.dart:89 from '_PanelSizeSource _panelSizeSource = _PanelSizeSource.unknown;' to '= _PanelSizeSource.measured;' (the pre-fix behaviour: treat the field initialiser as a measurement) -> 'with no rig it says the panel size is unknown and refuses to build' FAILED. Restored -> 7/7 pass.
fixes.caveats: Residual I assessed and deliberately left: the right-hand visual planner still draws the panel footprint to scale from the placeholder size over a 1-degree grid (visual_planner.dart:36-59, :311-330) when the size is unknown. Nothing in that preview is labelled - the grid lines are unlabelled at 8% alpha and no numbers are drawn - so it makes no readable angular claim, and both build actions are already dead, so I did not add a schematic mode for it.
